rows.label: qst610503_msg0001
rows.name:
Are you safe? The Invidian army
contacted us earlier, so I was
worried.

rows.label: qst610503_msg0003
rows.name:
A mercenary band eager for recognition
ignored the army's warning and went to
seize the Divine Beast weapons.

rows.label: qst610503_msg0004
rows.name:
Even if fighting breaks out, they have
no intention of invading, so they want
us to deal with it.

rows.label: qst610503_msg0005
rows.name:
They send notices worded to cover
themselves whether things go well or
badly... How selfish.

rows.label: qst610503_msg0006
rows.name: By the way... How was Ishaq?

rows.label: qst610503_msg0007
rows.name:
Looks like he found a place to be
useful here too. I'm sure he'll make a
fresh start and do his best.

rows.label: qst610503_msg0008
rows.name:
We caused trouble for the Special
Commissioner and party, but this was
probably a good opportunity for him.

rows.label: qst610503_msg0009
rows.name: Thank you all so very much.

rows.label: qst610503_msg0101
rows.name:
You should find Ishaq guarding
the Divine Beast Weapon Dig
Site in Temperantia.

rows.label: qst610503_msg0102
rows.name:
Could you go and make sure
he's carrying out his
assigned mission this time?

rows.label: qst610503_msg0103
rows.name: I leave it in your hands.
